title: ConfigKeyRegistry
description: contracts/config/keys.v1.json: the single configuration registry (SPEC §2.7). The Go loader, the Python loader and scripts/gen_config_docs.py read it; docs/CONFIGURATION.md and .env.example (only keys with advanced=false) are generated from it. Boot precedence: default < .env < process env. Runtime precedence (runtime: settable|seed): built-in < env seed < settings row, except that a non-empty env var always wins (env_managed).

groups.description: Display order of groups in generated docs and Settings -> All configuration.

ConfigKey.title: ConfigKey

aliases.description: Accepted alternative names; the canonical name wins when both are set.

services.description: Who reads the key: proxy (Go, G), engine (Python, P), compose (compose/Make, C), dashboard (container, D), build (frontend build, B), tools (trafficgen, doctor, configure, T).

kind.description: Value syntax. int/float: decimal. bool: true|false. duration: Go syntax (800ms, 5m, 2160h) in both services; 0 is allowed. bytes: non-negative integer byte count. url: absolute http(s) URL. enum: one of enum. list: comma-separated values (each in enum when enum is given). path: filesystem path. key_list: comma-separated label=key pairs.

default.description: The built-in default in env-var syntax. "" means unset/empty; null means there is no static default (generated, derived or backend-specific; see default_note).

compose_default.description: The value the shipped docker-compose.yml or container image sets.

shorthands.description: Accepted shorthand values and what they expand to.

secret.description: Never logged, never returned to the browser, masked in the UI, skipped by configure unless --with-secrets.

restart.description: Changing the value needs a restart (or a rebuild for build keys).

runtime.description: settable (R): also editable at runtime through the settings row. seed: seeds a runtime/policy value that is then edited in the dashboard or policy file.

ConfigKey.$comment: Cross-field rules (kind enum requires enum; a secret has no default; build keys are VITE_* and never secret) are checked by validate.mjs.
